name: cavity optomechanical element, self-sustained oscillation
question: Which write does the radiation-pressure coupling give under a laser-power sweep: a threshold write (static bistability) or a self-oscillation (phase memory)?
assumptions: alpha' = -(kappa/2) alpha + i(Delta + G x) alpha + E, m x'' = -m Om^2 x - m Gm x' + hbar G |alpha|^2 (Aspelmeyer eqs. 39-40) with X = G x in units of kappa

provenance.source: Aspelmeyer, M., Kippenberg, T. J., Marquardt, F., 'Cavity optomechanics', Rev. Mod. Phys. 86, 1391 (2014), arXiv:1303.0733 (full text)
